Learn how InstaDine's pay-per-order prepaid model, 5-minute onboarding, and counter workflow make restaurant operations effortless.

🔍
💳 Billing & Prepaid Credits

How does the Prepaid Order Credit model work?

+

InstaDine works like a prepaid mobile recharge. Instead of paying hefty $49–$99 monthly subscriptions, you purchase a pack of order credits (e.g. $5 for 500 orders or $20 for 3,300 orders).

Exactly 1 credit is deducted when your counter staff confirms payment for an order. If a customer opens the menu and abandons their cart or cancels, it costs you 0 credits.

What happens if a customer sends a fake or cancelled order?

+
Credits are only deducted when the cashier confirms payment ("Confirm & Paid"). Fake orders, prank orders, test orders, and cancelled orders cost you exactly zero credits. You are 100% protected.

Do prepaid credits ever expire?

+
No, credits never expire. Whether you use all your credits in a week or spread them over 6 months during seasonal business slowdowns, your balance remains safe in your wallet indefinitely.

What happens if my credits run out during a dinner rush?

+

We built a built-in 20-Order Grace Buffer. Your orders will never get cut off mid-service. Customers can continue ordering up to 20 orders past zero balance.

You can also enable Auto Top-Up, which automatically recharges your chosen credit pack whenever your balance dips below 20 credits.

Are there any platform commissions or monthly charges?

+
Zero commission. Zero monthly fees. We never take a cut of your order totals. You keep 100% of your customer payments.

Do different pricing plans have different features?

+

No! All features are 100% identical across every plan — even the /bin/zsh Free Pack.

Every restaurant gets full access to Dine-in & Takeaway QR menus, Kitchen KDS, Cashier Counter POS, Voice Alerts, Real-Time Sales, and Multi-Staff PINs. Based on your selected plan, only the confirmed orders count changes.

🏪 Hardware & Counter Workflow

Do I need to buy expensive POS hardware or thermal printers?

+
No specialized hardware required. The entire InstaDine system runs in standard web browsers on any smartphone, iPad, tablet, laptop, or desktop computer you already own. You can also connect standard Bluetooth thermal receipt printers if you wish.

How does the kitchen receive orders?

+
Once the cashier confirms payment, the order instantly pops up on the Kitchen Display Screen (KDS) (run on any budget tablet mounted on the kitchen wall), with an optional chime sound. Staff can mark dishes as "Preparing" or "Ready" in one tap.

Can I manage both Dine-In and Takeaway orders?

+
Yes! Table QR codes automatically route to Table Dining with table number auto-assigned. Counter QR codes allow customers in line to order for Takeaway Pickup with a token number. Both appear in your single counter dashboard.
📱 Customer Experience

Do customers need to download an app or sign up?

+
Never. Customers point their phone camera at the QR code and the menu loads in under 1 second in Safari or Chrome. No downloads, no passwords, no friction.

How do customers pay?

+
InstaDine supports Counter Payment (cash, card swipe, or your existing POS terminal) where the customer places the order on their phone and pays at the counter, as well as integrated online payments if you choose to enable them.
⏱️ Setup & Onboarding

Can I really set up my entire restaurant in 5 minutes?

+
Yes! Step 1 (2 mins): Enter restaurant name, trading hours, and auto-number tables. Step 2 (2 mins): Snap a photo of your printed menu and AI extracts all items, prices, and categories. Step 3 (1 min): Create staff cashier PINs. You're ready to take live orders immediately.

How do I print table QR stand labels?

+
In your dashboard, click "Print QR Stands" and InstaDine instantly generates an A4 or table-tent PDF with high-resolution QR codes numbered for Table #01 through your highest table number, ready for your standard office printer.
